text:
Marta (Finance): Orion Analytics invoice OR-4310 for $7,250 failed PO match. Vendor says PO OR-4310-2025 but Coupa matched to OR-4310 (assigned to another supplier). Due in 3 days. Who owns?
Ava (ProcureOps): Can we get the invoice PDF and vendor tax id? Looks like another supplier id collision.
Orion-AR (vendor): Uploaded PDF and portal screenshot. Tax ID 23-9876543. Our PO OR-4310-2025 was issued 2025-03-12 by your buyer. AR requests payment to avoid suspension.
invoicer-bot: Invoice OR-4310 received (auto-match confidence: 0%). Supplier mapping mismatch detected.
Liam (Ops): This purchase was for instrumentation by my team (PR-770). I approved the PR but procurement didn't finish issuing the formal PO last cycle.
Ava (ProcureOps): If procurement never created OR-4310-2025, we need either a retro PO or a vendor reissued invoice referencing existing PO OR-4310 linked to the correct supplier id. Legal/contract check first.
Sana (Legal): CLM shows SOW signed by vendor rep but our countersignature is missing. We need either countersign or an email from vendor accepting Redwood standard T&Cs to allow a retro PO.
Dex (Vendor Manager): I've pinged Orion to confirm acceptance of our standard T&Cs and to reissue invoice if they prefer. They asked if we can do a one-time manual match to clear payment quickly.
Marta (Finance): Bank last4 1198 verified by phone. Vendor asked to waive $75 late fee if paid within 48 hours. Can Payments do partial payout to avoid suspension?
Oliver (Payments): Treasury can authorize a 50% expedited payment with Ops and legal approval documented. Full payment requires PO match or exception approval from Head of Ops.
Ava (ProcureOps): Plan: create retro PO OR-4310-2025-retro, map supplier to correct id (6622), route to Liam (ops approval) and Sana (legal ACK commercial). Note in Coupa: "Retro PO to clear OR-4310 invoice; supplier id collision with OR-4310 assigned to other vendor."
Liam (Ops): I'll approve retro PO once legal ACKs and vendor confirms T&C acceptance.
Sana (Legal): If vendor emails explicit acceptance of our T&Cs I can provide commercial ACK within the hour.
Orion-AR (vendor): Sending T&C acceptance email now and can reissue invoice if you prefer.
Dex (Vendor Manager): Also updating supplier mapping ticket with ProcureOps to prevent future collisions.
Ava (ProcureOps): Creating OR-4310-2025-retro now and tagging approvers.
invoicer-bot: PO OR-4310-2025-retro created (status: pending approvals).
Marta (Finance): If approvals complete today, can Payments include invoice in tonight's expedited sweep (50% now, remainder on match)?
Oliver (Payments): Yes  we'll queue 50% for expedited sweep after Finance marks matched with approvals; remainder will be blocked until final match.
Marta (Finance): Great  vendor wants confirmation. Will update once legal ACK and PO approvals are in. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
